summary: Beacon Plaza is a 12-suite (66,360 SF) multi-tenant office property in Charlotte, NC. Certified rent roll as of 2026-08-31 shows 9 active, 1 pending, 2 vacant — unit and area occupancy both 75.00%. Underwriting per prescribed rules: GPR $1,615,200 (all-suite scheduled monthly on certified roll, pre-Suite-001 amendment, ×12), UW EGI $1,538,640, UW OpEx $499,423, UW NOI $1,039,217 (before reserves), UW NCF $1,035,617 (after reserves). Capitalized at 7.50% on NOI: value $13,856,224. Sized against 60% LTV / 1.25x DSCR / 9.0% DY at 6.75% (30-yr amort): maximum loan $8,313,734, LTV-bound. Net cash-out is +$1,685,597 after 1% origination, $45,000 closing, $6,500,000 payoff — no additional sponsor equity required. Two risks are present (manager including pending as leased; Suite 001 rollover within 12 months); five listed risks are absent, including refinance shortfall.

Physical-occupancy convention follows the manager cover: 'certified detail controls physical occupancy' — pending is not in possession. The manager's leased headline (10/12) counts pending; the reconciled underwriting count is 9/12.

Historical NOI ($1,003,656 cash-basis) and underwritten NOI ($1,039,217) are labeled distinctly. They use different definitions (cash collections vs. all-suite GPR × economic-loss adjustment plus other income, less prescribed expenses, management, and reserves), per the manager cover instruction to label each.

The Suite 001 in-place rent conflict between archive roll ($10,975) and certified roll ($11,050) is resolvable: the executed lease excerpt and PM correspondence (2026-08-31) confirm $11,050 as current in-place; the archive figure is pre-amendment. UW GPR uses the pre-amendment $10,975 by instruction; annual in-place rent uses the current $11,050.
Insurance policy limit ($2,000,000 GL aggregate) is distinct from the $56,658 annual insurance expense and is not double-counted.
Reimbursement income is already included in prescribed inputs (per instructions) and is not added again.
No photos, asking price, market sales/rent comps, or sponsor history are supplied. Their absence is labeled and no external inference is applied.
